links.outcome: Prospective silent-trial performance versus retrospective validation performance (AUROC, PPV, NPV)
links.effect: AUROC 0.88 (95% CI 0.88 to 0.89) retrospective vs 0.82 (95% CI 0.79 to 0.83) in prospective silent trial; PPV 0.19 and NPV 0.97 at retrospective-selected threshold.
links.quote: The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve was 0.88 (95% CI 0.88 to 0.89) for retrospective and 0.82 (95% CI 0.79 to 0.83) for prospective silent trial phases.

screen.reason: The study prospective validates a machine learning risk prediction model in a real-world silent trial (real deployment in silent mode), but it evaluates the model's accuracy rather than testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
